completionBlockers: The capture command result does not expose a capture ID or safe artifact path, so a probe cannot cryptographically correlate command success, the database row, and the file without inference.
The app has no acceptance-only data root plus isolated single-instance/IPC namespace; use a separate Windows user/profile to avoid forwarding to an unrelated primary instance.

manualChecks.procedure: Review sampled capture/scroll images, dictation transcript correlation, probe logs, resource trends, and database integrity output; reference hashes or report paths in the evidence document.
